title: What drives the emergence of symbolic mechanisms in large language models?
abstract: arXiv:2611.13270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has identified a set of emergent symbolic mechanisms that support abstract reasoning in large language models, but it remains unclear what factors drive the emergence of these mechanisms. To address this question, we trained neural networks from scratch on abstract sequence tasks, varying both architectural and data distributional factors, and investigated the effects of these factors on the emergence of symbolic mechanisms. Using representational, attentional, and causal mediation analyses, we first confirmed that transformer-based language models trained from scratch on our task developed symbolic mechanisms. We then found that, across multiple axes of data diversity, greater diversity produced stronger symbolic signatures. translated_title: 什么因素驱动了大语言模型中符号机制的涌现？
translated_abstract: 近期的研究识别出一系列支持大语言模型抽象推理的涌现符号机制，但尚不清楚是什么因素驱动了这些机制的涌现。为了解答这一问题，我们在抽象序列任务上从零开始训练神经网络，同时改变架构和数据分布方面的因素，并研究这些因素对符号机制涌现的影响。利用表征分析、注意力分析和因果中介分析，我们首先确认了在我们的任务上从零开始训练的基于Transformer的语言模型确实发展出了符号机制。随后我们发现，在多个数据多样性维度上，更大的数据多样性产生了更强的符号特征。令人惊讶的是，相同的特征在经过修改的Transformer架构甚至多层感知机（MLP）中也出现了，这表明架构归纳偏置对于符号机制的发展并非必要条件（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过从零训练神经网络并系统地操控架构与数据分布因素，发现数据多样性（而非架构归纳偏置）是驱动大语言模型中符号机制涌现的关键因素。
en_tdlr: By training neural networks from scratch while systematically varying architectural and data distributional factors, this study reveals that data diversity—rather than architectural inductive biases—drives the emergence of symbolic mechanisms in large language models.
